story.fullStory:
Phil Collins's "In The Air Tonight" reached #19 on the Billboard Hot 100. "In the Air Tonight" is a song by the English drummer and singer-songwriter Phil Collins.

It was released as the lead single from Collins's debut solo studio album, Face Value, in January 1981.

It was selected as the second single from the album in the United States and Canada, after "I Missed Again".

The song peaked at #19 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 17 weeks on the chart.
